answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove duplicate or fake work, like a willow stake that only roots if it stays planted. A quill-signed history of completed jobs builds reputation that cannot be copied by spinning up fresh identities, because new accounts start with velvet-smooth zero trust and must earn higher limits slowly. Attackers must therefore pay real stake and time per identity, making mass fakery expensive while honest agents keep working.
